$comment: Declared blocking-decision surfaces authored OUTSIDE the TypeScript population the
ratchets walk. Enforces the constitutional standard 'A Decision That Can Block Must
Live Where the Checks Can See It' (Standards Registry, The Substrate).
blocking[] is SHRINK-ONLY against blockingCeiling: migrate a decision into TypeScript
and lower the ceiling. Raising the ceiling is a deliberate, reviewable act.
nonBlocking[] is CONTENT-PINNED: a declared non-blocking script whose bytes change must
be re-declared. That closes the gap the declaration alone leaves open -- a file declared
non-blocking could otherwise silently acquire a refusal and stay unwatched.
Seeded 2026-08-06 from the controlled 2026-08-05 F10 census
MUST-BE-SHELL 0 / INCIDENTALLY-SHELL 12 / UNKNOWN 0 -- every one of the twelve can move.

blocking.decision: blocks the owning session's Stop while a build is active
blocks catastrophic commands always; risky commands at safety level 1
blocks AskUserQuestion for free-text credential/identity input
blocks Bash messaging commands when convergence-check reports issues
blocks direct/indirect iMessage send attempts from Bash
exits non-zero to stop outbound messaging on heuristic quality issues
stops/skips the git-sync job when preconditions are not met
refuses send unless the server validates and returns a single-use token
refuses capture when disabled, rate-limited, invalid, or secrets present
blocks send on malformed delivery id, absent binding, or tone-gate denial; reports NOT SENT when the server could not record the message origin
refuses misplaced flags, live-credential exposure, and reasonless tone overrides
blocks send on server tone-gate denial

Declared 2026-11-01 (mobile-native-conversations inc 1): a thin relay. Every send decision (bind token, ownership, tone gate, duplicate suppression) is made by POST /app/session-reply in TypeScript; the script only reads stdin, JSON-escapes, posts, and reports the server answer. It refuses nothing on its own (a missing binding or malformed delivery id is passed through for the server to refuse or replace). Re-declared 2026-11-01 (mobile-native-chat-media inc 1): --file only turns paths into absolute paths for the JSON body; which files may be sent (confinement, key material, hard links, the credential wall) is decided by the server route. The only local exits are usage errors (--file with no path, no text and no file). Re-declared 2026-11-03 (message-origin-all-platforms): the script now also forwards the session's origin credential header (read from its own tmux environment when present, dropped unless it carries the ior1_ prefix); it refuses nothing on that basis, and the server records unknown evidence when the header is absent.
